Rosen and others trace the beginnings of the iMedia revolution to the invention of the TV remote, which marking the first subtle shift of media control away from broadcasters and into the hands of the average couch potato. The destruction of our natural resources and contamination of our food supply continues occur, largely because of the extreme difficulty inaffixinglegal responsibility on those who continue to treat our environment with reckless abandon.
